rows.en:
(Morning classes are finally over...
Nobody told me they'd run ten minutes long...)

The school store's probably a lost cause now...
Should I sneak out to the convenience store...?

What's wrong, \p?
Haven't you had lunch yet?
No, my fourth-period class ran late...
rows.notes: Japanese 'hai' agrees with the negative question, so English 'No'.

rows.en: Hahaha, that's rotten luck.
It's no laughing matter...

Oh no, if I keep talking, it'll really sell out!
So, goodbye, Sensei!
Don't run in the hallway.
(Sigh, I hope there's something left...)

(Morning classes are finally overrr...
Nobody told me they'd run ten minutes long...)

The school store's probably a lost cause now...
I need a way to sneak out to the
convenience store...
It's not funny...

(Another tiring day...
Maybe I'll stop somewhere on the way home.)

Why the long face,
\p?

I don't have a long face.
I was just wondering what to do after school.

Hm... So you've got no one to hang out with...
How lonely.

D-don't jump to conclusions!
I've got people to hang out with.

Ha ha ha!
Well then, see you.
Okay, goodbye!

(...Now then, I'll grab someone who's free
and go have some fun.)

I don't have a long face, jeez...
I was just wondering what to do after school.

(...Now then, I'll grab someone who's free
and go have some fun.)
rows.notes: Male 'yatsu' vs female 'ko' (a girl friend implied); both neutral 'someone'.

rows.en: ...Yuuto, what are you doing?
rows.notes: Player line (male and 'single' occurrences); female twin c16896.

rows.en: (Summer break's started, but I'm so bored.)
I was thinking of heading to the pool now.
...By yourself?
Yeah, by myself.
...You're not inviting anyone?

I'm not going there to play. It's training.
And I'm already all set!
rows.notes: He starts taking his clothes off (swimsuit underneath), per the replies.

rows.en: H-hey, hold on! You don't have to strip...

Hahaha!
Just kidding.
(...That gave me a shock...)
...Kagura-kun, what are you doing?
Eek! Don't just start stripping out of nowhere!
(Ranka's debut concert is finally this weekend.)

\p.
You look like you're in a good mood.

Ranka's concert is this weekend.
Aren't you excited?

I couldn't get a ticket.
And I'm on duty that day, too.
Are you going to the concert?
...I figured I'd at least soak up the atmosphere.
rows.notes: Implies the player has no ticket either (Kagura answers 'that's too bad').

rows.en:
Haha! That's too bad.
Well, you can cheer her on from anywhere.
(I really wanted to see Ranka's concert...)

(Ranka-chan's debut concert is finally
this weekend.)

Ranka-chan's concert is this weekend.
Aren't you excited?
(I really wanted to see Ranka-chan's concert...)

(Hmm, what kind of place is this
newly discovered planet, anyway?)

Hey, \p.
Sounds like they've found a new planet.
Yuuto, what kind of planet do you think it is?
I hope it's an easy place to live.

I've lived on Frontier my whole life,
so part of me might not want to leave it.

Yeah.
Even though we were supposed to be looking
for a new home.
I guess it's that "home is where you settle" thing.
rows.notes: Proverb 'sumeba miyako' (wherever you live becomes the capital).

rows.en:
You said it.
Well, I'll be off.

(Hmm, what kind of place could this
newly discovered planet be, I wonder?)
Kagura-kun, what kind of planet do you think it is?

(...I woke up kinda early. I've got time
before school, so maybe I'll take a walk.)
Out running at this hour?

A pilot's body is everything, after all.
I make a point of running at this time
every morning.
Huh~ How far do you go?
Just a light 15 km or so.
That sounds plenty heavy to me...
Well, I'm off for my run.

(How does he run 15 km every morning
and still make it to school...?)

(...I woke up kinda early. I've got time
before school, so maybe I'll take a walk.)

(How does he run 15 km every morning
and still make it to school...?)

uncertain: c16920: 'konna jikan ni ranningu?' is shared with nml_myk_004 (Shirakawa scene, both genders); kept neutral.
c16903: player's 'at least enjoy the atmosphere' read as having no ticket, matching Kagura's 'that's too bad'.
